user.title: Connect to Nausto
user.description: Choose the entities for your boat. Open Boat → Sensors in Nausto, add a data source and enter its eight-character code here, or paste a copied pairing code. Older codes still work. The code expires after ten minutes. Then return to Nausto to choose which sensors to follow and connect them to the right components. Control is off until you allow it here. Select only switches and lights belonging to the boat. Separately select ordinary circuits that are safe to turn off. Other circuits are protected against being turned off, and that protection cannot later be removed here.

init.title: Sensors for Nausto
init.description: Choose the entities to offer to your boat. Open Sensors in Nausto to choose which ones to follow, assign components and select primary sources. Control is off until you allow it here. Select only switches and lights belonging to the boat. Separately select ordinary circuits that are safe to turn off. Other circuits are protected against being turned off, and that protection cannot later be removed here.
